description: This file defines a helper class 'BlazorComponent' that extends 'ComponentBase' in Blazor for reusable component functionality, including refresh logic.

classes.name: BlazorComponent
classes.description: A base component class that provides refresh capabilities using a shared broadcast instance.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the component's initialization to set up event handling for refresh requests.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Public method to trigger a refresh request via the broadcast instance.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Invoked when a refresh is requested; calls StateHasChanged to re-render the component.
